desc: Implement sieve computing number of distinct prime factors for all integers up to 10^6.
Collect m^2 for m with exactly 2 distinct prime factors into a sorted list.
Read Q queries via sys.stdin.buffer, answer each with bisect_right, write results to stdout.
Verify edge cases: A=36 → 36, A=10^12 → 10^12 (root 10^6 = 2^6·5^6 has exactly 2 distinct prime factors), and sample query 123456789 → 123454321 = 11111^2 (11111 = 41·271).
